description: This file defines a PHP class 'NotFound' within the Opencart Admin Controller namespace. The class handles 404 error page rendering, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading common layout components for the 'Not Found' error page.

classes.name: NotFound
classes.description: Controller class for handling 404 'Not Found' errors in the admin area of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the request to display the 'Not Found' error page. Loads language strings, sets the page title, builds breadcrumbs, and renders the view with common header, footer, and layout components.
